parameters.query: WITH rows AS (SELECT e AS j FROM jsonb_array_elements($1::jsonb) AS e), del AS (DELETE FROM memory_entries m USING rows r WHERE m.namespace = r.j->>'namespace' AND m.metadata->>'key' = r.j->>'key') INSERT INTO memory_entries (content, metadata, namespace, embedding, source_agent) SELECT j->>'content', j->'metadata', j->>'namespace', (j->>'embedding')::vector, j->>'source_agent' FROM rows
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memory_entries m WHERE m.namespace = '/memory/condominio' AND starts_with(m.metadata->>'key', $1 || '::')) AS ja_indexado
